comments.body:
From https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.0:
> Ruff now defaults to Python 3.11 instead of 3.10 when no Python version is configured through [target-version](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#target-version) or [requires-python](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/configuration/#inferring-the-python-version).

Is this what we want?
